title: Polymarket Leaderboard
description: Fetches the Polymarket trader leaderboard - top performers ranked by profit, volume, and win rate. Track who consistently wins bets and how much they profit. Perfect for identifying skilled traders to follow and reverse-engineer winning strategies.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

DATA = 'https://data-api.polymarket.com'

resp = requests.get(
    f'{DATA}/v1/leaderboard',
    params={'limit': 100, 'offset': 0},
    timeout=30,
)
resp.raise_for_status()
data = resp.json()

leaders = data
if isinstance(data, dict):
    leaders = data.get('data', data.get('leaderboard', data.get('results', [])))

now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())
rows = []
for i in range(len(leaders)):
    entry = leaders[i]
    rows.append({
        'rank': i + 1,
        'user_address': entry.get('proxyWallet', entry.get('address', '')),
        'username': entry.get('userName', entry.get('username', '')),
        'profit': float(entry.get('pnl', entry.get('profit', 0)) or 0),
        'volume': float(entry.get('vol', entry.get('volume', 0)) or 0),
        'markets_traded': int(entry.get('marketsTraded', entry.get('markets_traded', 0)) or 0),
        'positions_won': int(entry.get('positionsWon', entry.get('positions_won', 0)) or 0),
        'positions_lost': int(entry.get('positionsLost', entry.get('positions_lost', 0)) or 0),
        'win_rate': float(entry.get('winRate', entry.get('win_rate', 0)) or 0),
        'profile_image': entry.get('profileImage', entry.get('avatar', '')),
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
